# Synthetic package test audio

`package-speech.wav` is synthetic English speech generated with macOS `say`, converted to mono 16 kHz PCM with metadata removed. It contains only:

> Hello. This is a local voice recognition test. Please send the project update tomorrow morning.

No microphone recording or private conversation is included. This fixture checks local model loading and inference, not real-world recognition accuracy. See CONTRIBUTING.md for regeneration commands.
